items.headline: FDA approves first once-monthly injectable schizophrenia treatment
items.summary: The FDA approved Weltruza, a once-a-month shot of the antipsychotic olanzapine for adults with schizophrenia. It's the first subcutaneous version of the drug that needs no loading dose or hours of monitoring after each injection.
items.why_it_matters: A single monthly shot could help far more people with schizophrenia stay on treatment than a daily pill does.

items.headline: Nobel Peace Prize goes to human rights champion Navi Pillay
items.summary: The Norwegian Nobel Committee awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize to Navi Pillay, a South African jurist and former United Nations human rights chief, for decades of work promoting peace and international law.
items.why_it_matters: The award puts a global spotlight on international law and human rights enforcement at a moment when both are under heavy pressure.

items.headline: Federal judge rules Trump administration's use of voter data unlawful
items.summary: A federal judge found that the Justice Department broke the law by cross-checking state voter rolls against a federal immigration database. The judge said her ruling does not stop the government from taking lawful steps to help states keep their voter lists accurate.
items.why_it_matters: The ruling blocks a tactic that critics warned could wrongly strip eligible citizens from the voter rolls.
